Reproducibility: yes. Current main independently reports the full terminal buffer count while limiting each terminal stage to six rendered items, and the exact proof fixture reproduces the mismatch with nine completed outcomes.

target.title: fix(dashboard): keep OpenClaw Bay terminal outcomes visible
target.body:
## Summary

- keep distinct, proved OpenClaw Bay terminal outcomes visible instead of silently rendering only the first six
- use up to 12 staggered terminal slots per pool, selecting three columns only when the rendered terminal shoreline is at least 320px wide
- vary ambient lane conversations while keeping them explicitly non-operational flavour text

## Problem

The public Bay counter could correctly show, for example, `9 / 20` while the visual pool rendered only six completed crustaceans without saying that three were hidden.

## Implementation

- expand terminal-pool capacity from six to 12 items and show an explicit `+N more in the tide buffer` note after that limit
- choose the pool column count from the actual rendered shoreline width so reference labels remain readable on constrained displays
- retain deterministic, non-operational chat variants and Windows-safe LF handling for the proof runner

## API and performance boundary

This is presentation and proof work only. It does not change the Worker status schema, terminal-buffer merge/tide logic, dashboard cache, or browser polling cadence. Bay remains a cache-backed `/api/status` reader at 20 seconds (three browser-to-Worker requests per minute, compared with Overview's 15-second cadence). The browser proof records zero direct GitHub API and zero mutation requests.

## Validation and proof

- `pnpm run build:dashboard`
- `pnpm run lint:dashboard`
- `node --test --test-name-pattern "OpenClaw Bay is an unlisted" test/dashboard-worker.test.ts`
- `node --check docs/proof/openclaw-bay/run-proof.mjs`
- `git diff --check`
- deterministic Chromium proof via Crabbox local-container, lease `cbx_320bf6be31c9` (`blue-lobster`), image `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble`
  - 25 assertions and 17 evidence frames passed
  - proves nine completed outcomes render individually and constrained/wide terminal-pool layouts remain readable
  - zero direct GitHub API requests, mutation requests, console errors, and uncaught page errors

Tracked evidence:

- [`proof-summary.json`](docs/proof/openclaw-bay/proof-summary.json)
- [`playwright-proof-storyboard.jpg`](docs/proof/openclaw-bay/playwright-proof-storyboard.jpg)
- [`trace.zip`](docs/proof/openclaw-bay/trace.zip)

Codex review closeout:

- `codex review --uncommitted`: clean after accepted responsive-layout and proof-refresh findings were fixed
- `codex review --base origin/main`: clean after the final retry; no actionable defects

## Risks and rollout

The only user-facing change is the Bay demo's terminal-pool layout and ambient chat copy. Tide-counter and terminal-state semantics are unchanged. This follows the original experiment in #499 and needs no new configuration, credentials, or deployment path.

## Automated intake

This replacement intentionally uses the exact reviewed head from #515 and has no manual ClawSweeper command comment. It is ready for ClawSweeper's normal automatic intake.
